question.text: How many CM accounts can a broker generally hold for a stock exchange?

answer.text: Generally only one CM account per broker for a stock exchange, though CDSL requires a CM to open multiple accounts
Exactly five CM accounts per broker
Only with SEBI special permission for any account

explanation.text: The Logic: Generally, there is only one CM account per broker for a stock exchange. However, CDSL requires a CM to open multiple accounts. The Trap: Treating 'one CM account per broker' as an absolute rule misses the CDSL exception that requires multiple accounts. Note: The Series VI workbook (p.92) is the controlling source for the general one-CM-account-per-broker rule for a stock exchange and for the CDSL exception requiring multiple accounts.
